headline: Traders Price in 77% Odds of December Fed Rate Hike Following Jobs Report
summary: Traders increased the implied probability of a December Federal Reserve rate hike to 76.5% following a strong US jobs report.
why: Shifts in interest rate expectations affect global currency valuations, bond yields, and broader equity market sentiment.

impacts.name: US Federal Funds Rate
impacts.why: Rising rate-hike odds reflect market pricing for higher benchmark interest rates.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A stronger-than-expected US jobs report prompted traders to reprice monetary policy expectations, raising the probability of a Federal Reserve rate hike.
